content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To measure for roof shingles, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Sketch a rough birds-eye view of the roof structure (20 minutes)
Step 2. Research current local shingle price-per-square (30 minutes)
Step 3. Locate the heavy-duty extension ladder in the garage (10 minutes)
Step 4. Calculate the total number of bundles required including waste (15 minutes)
Step 5. Inspect the eaves for signs of rot or water damage (45 minutes)
Step 6. Check the chimney flashing for gaps or rust (20 minutes)
Step 7. Determine the pitch of the roof using a level and tape (15 minutes)
Step 8. Finalize the materials order list for the supplier (20 minutes)
Step 9. Measure the length of the ridge lines (25 minutes)
Step 10. Secure the ladder to the roof fascia for safety (5 minutes)
Step 11. Record the final square footage on the project estimate (10 minutes)
Step 12. Count the number of plumbing vent boots needed (10 minutes)
Step 13. Verify the delivery fee for the heavy pallet (5 minutes)
Step 14. Measure the length of the rake edges (30 minutes)
Step 15. Measure the width of the chimney base for flashing (10 minutes)
Step 16. Clear debris and leaves from the roof valleys (1 hour)
Step 17. Climb to the roof peak with a measuring tape (5 minutes)
Step 18. Check the weather forecast for the installation day (5 minutes)
Step 19. Measure the length and width of the main roof planes (40 minutes)
Step 20. Calculate the linear footage of the hip and ridge shingles (15 minutes)
Step 21. Put on a safety harness and fall protection gear (15 minutes)
Step 22. Measure the length of the drip edge along the perimeter (35 minutes)
Step 23. Find the safety harness kit in the basement (10 minutes)
Step 24. Measure the length of all roof valleys (30 minutes)
Step 25. Note the condition of the attic ventilation fans (15 minutes)
Step 26. Inspect the condition of the existing underlayment (25 minutes)
Step 27. Measure the dimensions of the skylight curbs (15 minutes)
Step 28. Set up the ladder on level ground (10 minutes)
Step 29. Calculate the amount of starter strip shingles needed (10 minutes)
Step 30. Look up the weight capacity of the roof decking (20 minutes)
Step 31. Measure the overhang of the existing shingles (10 minutes)
Step 32. Photograph the transition points for reference (15 minutes)
Step 33. Compare prices between two different hardware stores (40 minutes)
Step 34. Calculate the total linear feet of valley flashing (10 minutes)
Step 35. Determine the exposure of the current shingles (5 minutes)
Step 36. Sweep the area around the gutters (30 minutes)
Step 37. Measure the width of the gable ends (20 minutes)
Step 38. Check the gutters for shingle granule buildup (20 minutes)
Step 39. Schedule the delivery of the materials (10 minutes)
Step 40. Measure the area of the garage roof section (30 minutes)
